subject.title: refactor(agents): remove runtime migration fallbacks and post-split duplication

question: Should the published agent-harness runtime continue accepting `deferTerminalLifecycleEnd` during a deprecation window, or is this PR intentionally making a breaking external API removal?
rationale: The branch updates a generated SDK API baseline while deleting a previously accepted lifecycle option; repository policy requires an explicit compatibility direction for shipped external APIs.

options.title: Preserve the deprecated alias
options.body: Restore the field as a documented deprecated input and normalize it once at the public boundary while internal code uses only `deferTerminalLifecycle`.

options.title: Approve a breaking removal
options.body: Accept removal only with explicit maintainer confirmation of the external contract change and a documented upgrade path for plugin and integration callers.

recommendation.title: Preserve the deprecated alias
recommendation.body: Restore the field as a documented deprecated input and normalize it once at the public boundary while internal code uses only `deferTerminalLifecycle`.
